title: Best early Prime Day robot vacuum deals: Save on Roborock, Eufy, Dreame
excerpt: Spend your time (and money) on things you actually enjoy instead.
content_html:

The best Prime Day robot vacuum deals at a glance:

Best Robot Vacuum Deal

Best Premium Robot Vacuum Deal

Best Budget Robot Vacuum Deal

Prime Big Deal Days, Amazon's two-day sale for Prime members, kicks off on Oct. 6, but you don't have to wait until the calendar rolls over to shop some excellent deals. It's a great time to pick up a robot vacuum, and you can start shopping for one right now, in fact.

A robot that's on vacuum or even mop duty can be a massive help when hosting a full house over the holidays, or it can keep your home tidy year-round with regularly scheduled cleaning. It can keep up with crumbs and tracked-in dirt between visits while you deal with the cooking and decorating, or while you're just living your best life.

Robot vacuums come in a pretty wide range. Some models can basically just vacuum on a schedule you set in an app, while others also mop, map each room of your house, and empty themselves into a base that holds weeks of debris. It really just depends on what you're looking for. And right now, robot vacuums of all stripes are discounted.

Mashable Trend Report

Amazon adds new deals several times a day, and the best ones can sell out fast, so we'll keep checking prices and updating this list until the sale ends. For now, these are the best robot vacuum deals you can get right now ahead of the sale. Be sure to check back for new deals before and during the big days.

Credit: Amazon

$599.98 at Amazon
$999.99 Save $400.01

Why we like it

This model doesn't just vacuum. It includes a roller mop that gets rinsed with clean water while it cleans, so it can scrub up everything from coffee spills to dried-on sauce without spreading dirty water around your floors. It also has 20,000 Pa of suction and brushes designed to keep pet hair from tangling around them, plus an arm that extends out to reach dirt along baseboards and in corners.

Best premium robot vacuum deal

Credit: Amazon

$949 at Amazon
$1,499.99 Save $550.99

Why we like it

This heavy-duty unit can slip under couches and low cabinets, with a laser sensor on top that lowers itself when needed. Plus, its chassis automatically lifts up so it can climb over thresholds between rooms. It also has 22,000 Pa of suction and brushes that resist hair tangles, which helps when it's pulling pet fur out of carpet. It can sanitize on its own, as well as wash its mops in 176 degree Fahrenheit water and dry them with hot air. That means you can stay hands-off while it handles all the cleaning and refilling.

Best budget robot vacuum deal

Credit: Amazon

$329.99 at Amazon
$549.99 Save $220

Why we like it

This affordable robot vacuum can handle cleanup all on its own at a great price. It can empty itself into its dock after each cleaning, and the bag holds up to 70 days of dust and hair. Both of its brushes are designed to keep long hair from wrapping around them, and a LiDAR sensor maps your home so it can plan an efficient route through each room.
